description: This file defines the interface `ReportData` in the OrangeHRM project, situated under the namespace `OrangeHRM\Core\Report`. It specifies method signatures for normalizing data and retrieving metadata related to report data objects.

classes.name: ReportData
classes.description: An interface that enforces normalization of report data objects to arrays and retrieval of optional metadata.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the report data object into an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns associated metadata as a ParameterBag object or null.
